groups.title: CloudFormation Templates
groups.question: Explain how a CloudFormation template describes infrastructure and how one template can serve many environments.

followUps.Template Anatomy and Intrinsic Functions: How do intrinsic functions like Ref and Fn::GetAtt let one template work across environments, and how do circular dependencies happen?
followUps.Nested Stacks and Cross-Stack References: When would you use nested stacks instead of cross-stack references, and what makes cross-stack exports hard to change later?

groups.title: Change Management
groups.question: Walk through how you would change live infrastructure safely with CloudFormation.

followUps.Change Sets and Rollback Triggers: What could a change set warn you about before an update, and what do rollback triggers add on top?
followUps.Drift Detection and Remediation: Why is drift dangerous for the next stack update, and how would you handle it?

groups.title: AWS CDK
groups.question: Explain what the AWS CDK adds on top of plain CloudFormation templates.

followUps.CDK Constructs and Apps: What is the difference between L1, L2, and L3 constructs, and when would you drop down to L1?
followUps.CDK Pipelines for CI/CD: What does it mean that a CDK pipeline is self-mutating, and why is that useful?

groups.title: StackSets and Multi-Account Deployments
groups.question: Explain how you would roll out the same infrastructure to many accounts and keep templates correct.

followUps.CloudFormation StackSets: How would you use StackSets to give every new account a security baseline, and what do failure tolerance settings control?
followUps.cfn-lint and Template Validation: What kinds of problems does cfn-lint catch, and what does cfn-guard check that cfn-lint does not?
